raw_text: The Wire has independently verified that the viral audio clip attributed to the Defence Minister is a sophisticated AI deepfake. Audio forensics firm Attestiv confirmed the clip was generated using voice synthesis technology, with the source voice likely trained on publicly available speeches and parliamentary recordings. The fabrication raises serious concerns about AI-generated disinformation targeting national security.
